findings.problem: AM68 glob *verdict* is met by the fixed suffix loop-record.py:563 always appends, so any malformed-block message passes, whichever field it names
findings.scenario: mutant ledger_problem returning 'sha256 missing…' for every block keeps --day-only 67/67 green (verifier m1)

findings.problem: no case pins fix-base.round's digest to sha256 of the route file content (G32 checks the '1 ' prefix only, G47 seeds a foreign digest, G49 reruns the same path)
findings.scenario: mutant hashing the path or a constant keeps test-gate-route.sh green; a fresh review rewriting route-review-1.json at the same path then keeps the stale base (verifier m2a/m2b)
findings.closure: G32 asserts fix-base.round's second field equals sha256sum of the routed file, and a new case rewrites the same path with other content and expects written + a changed fix-base

findings.problem: SG14 runs GIT_DIR=x git stash on a dirty tree with no reason needle, so the could-not-check (git_env) branch of the stash ask is unproved
findings.scenario: mutant stash_rule passing git_env=False to worktree_clean keeps every shipped case green; on a clean tree GIT_INDEX_FILE=x git stash loses the stash ask (verifier m3)
findings.closure: on the tracked-clean tree after SG8, a case 'GIT_INDEX_FILE=x git stash' expects ask with the stash needle, and SG14 gains the needle

findings.problem: pre-existing, outside the spec: a pure insertion appended after the last case may bind at top level a name the frozen cases use (from app.services.c import g + a new case with an assertion), allowed with no verdict
findings.scenario: B1/B2 assert g(..) from app.services.b; appended import rebinds g for every frozen case; same at 309dc3e
